policy.note: Silvia Etsy listings use free shipping in the managed Etsy profile. Sensaria Basic shipping is absorbed by Silvia and reduces profit.

markets.label: Canada
markets.taxNote: 5% supplier tax was verified on an actual British Columbia Sensaria GO checkout. Other Canadian destinations may differ.
